map.为何用内标法？: Why use the internal standard method?
map.进样量波动被内标峰面积比抵消，比外标法更耐针间误差。: Injection volume fluctuations are cancelled by the internal standard peak area ratio, so it tolerates injection-to-injection error better than the external standard method.
map.干燥失重怎么处理？: How is loss on drying handled?
map.报告含量常按干燥品计：含量(干)=含量(湿)/(1−LOD/100)。: Reported content is often on a dry basis: content(dry) = content(wet)/(1-LOD/100).

map.内标法含量：内标在样品溶液中浓度 Cis = 内标量 ÷ 定容体积；目标物浓度: Internal-standard content assay: internal-standard concentration in the sample solution Cis = internal standard amount ÷ final volume; target concentration Cx = correction factor f × (Ax ÷ Ais) × Cis (mg/mL); total target amount = Cx × final volume (mL); content (wet basis) = total target amount ÷ sample weight × 100%; content (dry basis) = wet-basis content ÷ (1 − loss on drying%).
